name: phanbo-idosi
description: Hệ thống quản lý kho và phân bổ hàng hóa IDOSI

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @idosi/api && npm run build -w @idosi/worker && npm run build -w @idosi/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @idosi/contracts && npm run build -w @idosi/domain && npm run build -w @idosi/database && npm run build -w @idosi/ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm -w @idosi/api run dev" "npm -w @idosi/worker run dev" "npm -w @idosi/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:packages && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
